quarterly_data.signal: Q3 FY2026 results release (Exhibit 99.1): Twist shipped products to approximately 2,650 customers versus approximately 2,480 a year earlier, and physically shipped approximately 369,000 genes versus approximately 237,000. Net loss was $35.1 million, or $0.56 per diluted share, versus net income of $20.4 million a year earlier, which included a gain of $48.8 million from the spin out of Atlas Data Storage. Research and development expenses were $18.0 million and SG&A $80.7 million. The raised FY2026 revenue guidance of $456 million to $457 million compares with prior guidance of $442 to $447 million.
